content:
The Optimal Run v1.1 by SolarFrost#2809
**Received permission from creator to post in their stead**
**Note: This is just Solar's personal route, you are feel free to run anything you see more efficient**

Starts Speedrun. (numbers in bracket is your portal)
Kill Green Mush (1)
Kill Frog (2)
Kill 1-2 beans for red mushroom portal too. (4)
Kill slime for a bit for sticks portal too (6)
Cast Void Radius in Stick (7) 
Kill Nuttos (8)

Teleport to Snake/Boa (9)
Kill Carrots for minigame portals (11)
**Kill Glublins (12)**
Kill Wodeboard for Boss Portal and **Gigafrogs**, yes the boss door have a hidden portal. You can unlock it (14)
Kill Nightmare Amarok (17)
Teleport to sticks and cast Voidal to unlock TD portal (18)
QUICKLY while buff is on, teleport to WORLD 3 SHEEPS and start grinding up to Comb Mustache (19)
Kill Snowflakes (20)
Kill Combs (21)
TP back to World 2 Sands (22)
Kill Mimics **for bandit bob portal too (24)**
Kill Crabcakes (25)
Kill Mafioso (26)
Kill Sandcastle (27)
Kill Pincermin (28)

TELEPORT back to Combs Void Radius and start killing combs until Rams is open (29)

TELEPORT to POOP(30)
Kill Rats (31)

TELEPORT to Potato (32)
Kill Tyson (33)
Kill Moonmen (34)
Kill Sand Giants (35)
Kill Snelbies for Boss Door Portal (36)
Kill Nightmare Efaunt (39)

**Teleport to Bloques (40)**
At this point use Void Radius whenever you can.
Kill Mamooth (41)
Kill Snowman (42)
Kill Penguin (43)
Kill Thermeister (44)
Kill Cyrosnake (45) 
Kill Boombox (46)

CAST Void Radius at Eye for Boss room Portal (47)
Defeat Nightmare Chiz (50)

TELEPORT to Purple Mush (51)
Kill TV (52)
Kill Donut (53)
**TELEPORT** to Suggma and kill them (54) or continue W4 your choice.

All portal counts are at the below link
https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1109526896640807002/1112461195614617762

yeah, I did show some stuffs in the last videos at first but that run took me 2 weeks and there are just too many things so I just skip them after the second run
all you need to know is base mk at mushrooms and dmg so try to get these numbers
always max mk first, the rest is dmg/respawn then try to squeeze some extra dmg if you are close to next tier at hardest 4monsters you can reach (I reroll obols usually or get dmg from w2boss rotation, new killroy) 

my setup includes pretty much everything in the game at the max for 85 run
lab: 5x wood, 2x card (star in very rare scenario) one double dmg card is usually enough to push all monster to next tier
extra mk: shiny pets 15, 46%dn bosses, had to buy all w6 cards, half obols mk% max luk
extra dmg: second half obols stats%, some % new updates, helpful saved 2k trash 4b atoms, new max books, finally got shimmer book, xxk dmg/stat bubbles, tome 0.01%
...it's just everything

75 portals for f2p/normal players without world rings 
50kT dmg, 50k% mk at mushrooms, respawn items should do it I think
